plan.title: Service PR to RFQ award and PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule; the catalog cannot set the separate evaluation duration.
Invite the vendors mapped by the product, without inventing supplier names.

args.goal: add one Required T&C clause on the buyer's RFQ create screen and save it, then stop on the create screen

steps.note: Handle the required T&C clause, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Verify that publishing reached the real project page.
Submit Vendor A's quote at 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A's quote was submitted.
Submit Vendor B's lower quote at 90 through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor B's quote was submitted.
Wait for bidding to end before opening Master QCS and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding closes.
Assert that the lowest bid is ranked first, establishing Vendor B as L1.
Award all available line items to the lowest-ranked vendor.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for award to the lowest bidder.

steps.note: Approve the proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete PO creation from the approved award and read the resulting purchase orders.
Verify that both PR activities appear as PO lines with quantities.
Return to the events list to inspect the event's history placement.
Open the History tab after the event has completed.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
